scope: Only the supplied 147 exact historical commit/path/rule/line findings; no broad rule/path suppression.

derivation.algorithm: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators comma/colon, no trailing newline
derivation.purpose: Deterministic binding between an inventoried source site, source/scanner bytes and its review; the verifier recomputes and compares it for review-integrity, not authentication.
